field.label: Enable
field.help: Look for events at the interval below and send them to the enabled channels. Gateway alarms and CARP transitions are reported straight away.

field.label: Check interval
field.help: How often to look for events. Gateway alarms and CARP changes are reported straight away whatever this is set to, so a longer interval mainly delays Monit and System Status. System Status is checked at most every 5 minutes either way.

field.label: Only when CARP master
field.help: Stay quiet while this firewall is the standby of a CARP pair, so only the master reports. Ignored when no CARP virtual IPs exist.

field.label: Title prefix
field.help: What to put in front of every notification title, to tell firewalls apart. Choose None when the channel already names this firewall, as a Discord webhook's bot name does.

field.label: Prefix text
field.help: Text to put in front of every notification title.

field.label: Combine messages from
field.help: Send one summary instead of separate notifications when this many events arrive in the same check. Enter 0 to always send them separately.

field.label: Gateway latency and loss
field.help: Also notify when a gateway reports high latency or packet loss, not only when it goes down.

field.label: Gateway hold time
field.help: How long a gateway must stay in its new state before it is reported, so a flapping link does not fill a channel. With no hold it is reported by the next check, which a gateway alarm triggers immediately.

field.label: Report successful logins
field.help: Report every successful login as well as failures and lockouts. Failures and lockouts are always reported when a channel takes login events.

field.label: Intrusion alert severity
field.help: Which intrusion detection alerts to report. Suricata writes many alerts, so high only is a sensible start; the Combine setting groups bursts into one message.

field.label: Daily update check
field.help: Check for firmware updates daily at around 04:00. Without it, updates are only reported after a check runs from the dashboard, the firmware page or a cron job.

field.label: Certificate warning (days)
field.help: Notify when a certificate or authority in System: Trust expires within this many days, and again once it has expired. Certificates are checked hourly.

field.label: System Status level
field.help: Lowest severity of System Status entries to send. These are the alerts behind the bell icon in the menu bar, such as crash reports, low disk space and expired certificates. Notice also includes configuration override warnings.
